description: This file defines the ICatalogViewModelService interface which provides methods for fetching catalog items, brands, and types in an asynchronous manner for an e-commerce web application.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of catalog items filtered by optional brand and type IDs.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Retrieves a list of brand options for filtering the catalog.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of type options for filtering the catalog.
